messages:
olga: posting a new idea for the autoscale row — single-line min/max steppers, tiny SLO chip, and a compact burst trigger. aim: show most info without needing expansion. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/one-line-rows (frame Compact-new)
mike: visual looks good. concern: burst badge is too ambiguous as a control. Suggest turning it into an icon-button (16px thunder) with a clear focus ring and an inline caret so users know it opens a popover.
tara: copy: change 'Burst capacity' -> 'Short burst' and label SLO as 'Latency target (ms)'. For guardrails wording, prefer "Autoscaling may temporarily reduce capacity under extreme conditions" instead of the current "scale below your min" phrasing.
zayn: engineering: steppers must accept left/right arrow increments + direct typing. save behavior: debounce 700ms and batch updates if multiple fields change quickly. persist last burst quanta per pool in localStorage so users don't re-enter values. Also surface a tiny est cost delta when pool is switched (muted microline).
sophia: accessibility checklist: 1) burst icon has aria-label including pool name, 2) aria-live="polite" region for stepper changes, 3) focus order min -> max -> SLO -> burst, 4) tooltips keyboard-focusable and <250 chars, 5) contrast for 12px text >= 4.5:1, 6) 44px touch targets on mobile.
olga: thanks, I'll iterate: make burst an icon-button with aria-label and caret, add 1px divider between steppers and burst, add hover or pool-switch microline with "est +$0.10/min • est p95 +10ms", implement debounce and localStorage for burst quanta, and add PR checklist with the a11y items. aiming to push updated mock by EOD. :rocket:
